ukkirati：ဥက္ကိရတိ（ကြိ）

ထုတ်ဆောင်၏၊ ထား၏၊ ပြုလုပ်၏။
R:
ukkirati：ဥက္ကိရတိ （ဥဒ်√ကိရ်）
တူးထုတ်၏။ တူးယက်၏။
DOP: ukkirati pr. 3 sg. [ S. utkirati], digs out, excavates; carves, engraves ; Sp 290, 23 (kakkaṭakkhīni ~anti); — absol. ( a ) ukkiritvā, Sp 290, 16 (tasmiṃ bandhanaṭṭhāne valayam iva ~itvā lekhaṃ ṭhapenti); 862, 30 (sukkhāya nadiyā vālikaṃ ~itvā kata-āvāṭakesu pi nhāyituṃ vaṭṭati); ( b ) ukkiritvāna, Vin-vn 1623 (vālikaṃ ~itvāna); — pp ukkiṇṇa , mfn. [ S. utkīrṇa], dug out, excavated ; Ja IV 106, 22´ (~-ttā, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se okiṇṇattā); — ~’-antaraparikha, mfn. , with ditches dug at intervals ; Ja IV 106, 16* (~’-antaraparikhaṃ … idaṃ puraṃ, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se okiṇṇ’-; 106, 22´ : antarantarā udakaparikhānaṃ kaddamaparikhānaṃ sukkhaparikhānaṃ ca ukkiṇṇattā ~’-antaraparikhaṃ, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se okiṇṇattā okiṇṇ’-); — ~-parikha, mfn. , with a ditch dug (round) ; D I 105, 13 ; — see also okiṇṇa 2 .
CPD: ukkirati , pr. 3 sg. [ sa. utkirati], to dig, make a hole; to carve, sculpture, engrave ( references: ct.s, Vin-vn, ṭīkās); nadīpāraṃ gacchanto vāḷikaṃ ~itvā kata- āvaṭesu pi nahāyati, Kkh 121, 20 ≠ Sp 862, 30 ; (gaṇ- ṭhika-paṭṭakañ ca pāsaka-paṭṭakañ ca) ... kakkafak- khīni ~anti, Sp 290, 23 (= nīharanti karonti ṭhapenti, Vjb B e 1960 122, 21 ); (chatta-daṇḍe) bandhana-ṭṭhāne valayam iva ~itvā lekhaṃ ṭhapenti, 290, 15 (ninnaṃ unnataṃ vā katvā, Vmv B e 1960 l 166, 19 ); vālikaṃ ~itvāna, Vin-vn 1623; ~itvā katā lekhā bandhan'- atthāya vaṭṭati, 3033 (ṭ = uṭṭhāpetvā); valayaṃ ~ituṃ vaṭṭati, Vin-vn-ṭ B e 1962 ll 352, 15 ; chinditvā ti ~itvā kataṃ chinditvā, 352, 2 ( ad Vin-vn 3032); ≠ Vinayâlaṅkāra-ṭ B e 1962 l 34, 2, 8 .
